description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseServerConnection class which manages database connections in the OrangeHRM system's installer module. It provides singleton-style access to a Doctrine DBAL connection configured for MySQL, including establishing the connection with parameters and registering type mappings.

classes.name: DatabaseServerConnection
classes.description: Provides a singleton interface to establish and access a Doctrine DBAL database connection configured for MySQL, including type mapping registration.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton Doctrine DBAL connection, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stored database connection, allowing for reinitialization.
